primitives.name: Air Density and Wind Effect
primitives.verbatim_quote: AIR: venue air density 1.2264 kg/m3 measured at Mercedes-Benz Stadium [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-18/weather-pilot/weather-stadium-pilot.json] -> ball carries measurably differently than a sea-level-standard model assumes ; wind 15.8 km/h qualifies it -> deep-ball and kick distances shift; totals and long-DK props carry the effect, spreads barely 2.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d': 'distance shift (m)', 'k': 'proportionality constant (dimensionless)', '\\rho_{\\text{air}}': 'air density (kg/m³)', '\\rho_0': 'standard air density (kg/m³)', 'v_{\\text{wind}}': 'wind velocity (km/h)'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear dependence of distance on air density and wind speed; standard atmospheric model applies locally.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \rho_{\text{air}} \) deviates significantly from \( \rho_0 \) or \( v_{\text{wind}} > 20 \) km/h.

layer2.mapping: Modulates expected deep-ball and kick distances in GSE scripts; informs GSI probabilistic adjustments for totals and long-DK props.
layer2.telemetry: Ball carry distance variance relative to sea-level baseline.
